class.name: BoneClothCollisionTaperedCapsule3D
class.brief_description: A capsule shape collision with a different radius at each end that interacts with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A capsule shape collision with a different radius at each end that interacts with [BoneClothSimulator3D], such as for a thigh. Its axis is the node's Y axis, with [member top_radius] at the +Y end.

members.member: The radius of the -Y end. [b]Note:[/b] A radius greater than half of [member height] raises the [member height] to twice the radius.
The full height, including the end spheres. [b]Note:[/b] A [member height] less than twice a radius lowers that radius to half of the [member height].
If [code]true[/code], the collision acts to trap the joints within the collision.
The radius of the +Y end. [b]Note:[/b] A radius greater than half of [member height] raises the [member height] to twice the radius.
